## API at a glance

| Method | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `loadConfigOrDefault` | `loadConfigOrDefault() -> result` | Load the configuration saved by the last successful init(). |
| `init` | `init(cfg: tstr) -> bool` | Create a new storage node instance and configure it. |
| `start` | `start() -> bool` | Start the storage node. |
| `stop` | `stop() -> result` | Stop the storage node. |
| `destroy` | `destroy() -> result` | Destroy the storage context and free all resources. |
| `isRunning` | `isRunning() -> bool` | Check whether the storage node is running. |
| `libstorageVersion` | `libstorageVersion() -> result` | Get the libstorage version string. |
| `moduleVersion` | `moduleVersion() -> tstr` | Get this module's version, as declared in `metadata.json`. |
| `dataDir` | `dataDir() -> result` | Get the storage data directory path. |
| `network` | `network() -> result` | Get the Logos network this node was configured for. |
| `peerId` | `peerId() -> result` | Get the node's peer ID. |
| `spr` | `spr() -> result` | Get the node's Signed Peer Record (SPR). |
| `debug` | `debug() -> result` | Get debug information for the node. |
| `collectMetrics` | `collectMetrics()` |  |
| `updateLogLevel` | `updateLogLevel(logLevel: tstr) -> result` | Set the log level at runtime. |
| `connect` | `connect(peerId: tstr, peerAddresses: [tstr]) -> result` | Connect to a peer. |
| `uploadUrl` | `uploadUrl(filePath: tstr, chunkSize: int, advertise: bool) -> result` | Upload a local file by absolute path. |
| `uploadInit` | `uploadInit(filename: tstr, chunkSize: int, advertise: bool) -> result` | Create a manual upload session for chunk-by-chunk streaming. |
| `uploadChunk` | `uploadChunk(sessionId: tstr, chunk: tstr) -> result` | Upload a single data chunk for a session created with uploadInit(). |
| `uploadFinalize` | `uploadFinalize(sessionId: tstr) -> result` | Finalize a manual upload session and retrieve the CID. |
| `uploadCancel` | `uploadCancel(sessionId: tstr) -> result` | Cancel an ongoing upload session. |
| `downloadToUrl` | `downloadToUrl(cid: tstr, filePath: tstr, local: bool, chunkSize: int, isPrivate: bool, advertise: bool) -> result` | Download content by CID and write it to a local file. |
| `downloadChunks` | `downloadChunks(cid: tstr, local: bool, chunkSize: int, isPrivate: bool, advertise: bool) -> result` | Download content by CID and deliver it as a stream of base64-encoded chunks. |
| `downloadCancel` | `downloadCancel(sessionId: tstr) -> result` | Cancel an ongoing download session. |
| `exists` | `exists(cid: tstr) -> result` | Check whether content identified by CID exists in local storage. |
| `fetch` | `fetch(cid: tstr, isPrivate: bool, advertise: bool) -> result` | Fetch content from the network and cache it locally in the background. |
| `getAdvertise` | `getAdvertise(cid: tstr) -> result` | Check whether the dataset is announced to the DHT and served to peers. |
| `setAdvertise` | `setAdvertise(cid: tstr, advertise: bool) -> result` | Enable or disable DHT announcements and serving to peers for a dataset. |
| `remove` | `remove(cid: tstr) -> result` | Remove content identified by CID from local storage in the background. |
| `space` | `space() -> result` | Get storage space information. |
| `manifests` | `manifests() -> result` | List all manifests stored locally. |
| `downloadManifest` | `downloadManifest(cid: tstr, isPrivate: bool, advertise: bool) -> result` | Fetch the manifest for a given CID in the background. |
| `importFiles` | `importFiles(path: tstr)` | Import all files from a directory (headless helper). |

| Event | Payload | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `storageStart` | `storageStart(payload: tstr)` | Emitted when start() has finished starting the node. |
| `storageStop` | `storageStop(payload: tstr)` | Emitted when stop() has finished stopping the node. |
| `storageConnect` | `storageConnect(payload: tstr)` | Emitted when connect() has finished connecting to the peer. |
| `storageUploadProgress` | `storageUploadProgress(payload: tstr)` | Emitted as uploadUrl() or uploadChunk() upload data. |
| `storageUploadDone` | `storageUploadDone(payload: tstr)` | Emitted when uploadUrl() finishes. |
| `storageDownloadProgress` | `storageDownloadProgress(payload: tstr)` | Emitted as downloadToUrl() or downloadChunks() receive data. |
| `storageDownloadDone` | `storageDownloadDone(payload: tstr)` | Emitted when downloadToUrl() or downloadChunks() finishes. |
| `storageDownloadManifestDone` | `storageDownloadManifestDone(payload: tstr)` | Emitted when downloadManifest() finishes. |
| `storageRemoveDone` | `storageRemoveDone(payload: tstr)` | Emitted when remove() finishes. |
